contexts.text: Bottles, etc. = those things which are contained in them. Illustrated.
Bottles filled with iron filings... TCR 116:end.
Like a bottle containing worms... TCR 258.
Their mouth is like a bottle of honey, and their heart is like a bottle of gall.
Wine = truth, and bottles, the Knowledges which contain it.
Earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter () = evils of life and falsities of doctrine which are from man's Own intelligence. (See also AE 177.)
Old bottles () = the statutes and judgments of the Jewish Church, and new bottles, the Lord's injunctions and commands.
Every bottle shall be filled with wine () = the mind of man, for this is a recipient of truth or falsity, as a bottle is of wine.
